g.text: DERP: a relay that forwards encrypted packets by public key
Both devices connect OUTWARD over HTTPS (TCP 443), so no inbound hole is needed.
relays also talk to each other
The relay reads only the destination key.
DERP is also the bootstrap path (traffic starts here while direct paths are probed) and the fallback when direct fails.
To a firewall it looks like ordinary HTTPS (an HTTP Upgrade, which "looks exactly like WebSockets" per Tailscale's source).
